It is labelled a conviction, but it sits under the same heading as the measured first screen. scores.q: Q1 How representable is the project
scores.why: The README's first screen (README.md lines 1-25) is honest and complete about standing. Within 3-4 minutes it covers what the account is, one case, what it is for, the two ethics premises, the Lean receipts (505 of 536), that none of the central results is new mathematics, that tests have both passed and failed, and that no person has reviewed it. ONE-PAGE.md then gives a table of claims, standings and refuters. A newcomer cannot yet say in their own words what the project is or why it matters. 'Within one relational unfolding', 'couples into', 'continuation condition', 'widening what can form', 'central declarations' and 'grammar laws' all appear before any of them is explained. The first screen does not tie the case to the use: the bed is the thing the fishers' selection does not read. Below the first screen, the README's 86 KB are mostly the 22-28 minute first-person opening, followed by make commands and 'Historical section links'. So a reader who scrolls instead of clicking lands in a manifesto.

scores.q: Q1. Representable from where a newcomer lands
scores.why: README's first screen (read lines 1-30) and the site home (read as text and as a rendered thumbnail) say in 3-4 minutes what the account is, give one concrete case with its failures, what it is for, the two unasserted premises, Lean receipts with the 'none new mathematics' verdict, 'No human review yet', and the spine with the 11/117 standing. ONE-PAGE (read in full) adds a claim / standing / refuter table. What holds it below 8: the first screen relies on terms a newcomer can't parse yet ('one relational unfolding', 'couples into', 'C', 'central declarations', 'grammar laws'). Just below it on GitHub, the README carries the whole first-person opening ('the most important matter at this moment in the whole history of the Earth', 'I take it to be the truth, the dharma, the Dao'). It is labelled a conviction, but it is the next thing a scrolling reader meets.

scores.q: Q3. Unification and connections shown elegantly and honestly
scores.why: Honesty is strong. The spine (theories/becoming/results/spine.svg, rendered and its text read) keeps edge kinds apart: formal-reuse solid, darker when backward; interpretive dashed; application dotted; 'related' (1,420 analogy edges) not drawn and said so, with pairs under 10 uses left out and counted. It prints the 11 / 1 / 6 / 99 standings banner, brings both premises into 07 as hypotheses, and colours T1-T8 by outcome. THEORY-GRAPH.md 'The spine: what it shows and does not show' says the curves draw neither the 45 that reach the grammar nor the 11 derived, and that spokes count modules, not results. The edge-kinds table gives every pair by kind. 08 §7 has both four-way tables, and the map's 'How far the root reaches' view says the strictest sense of unified is the 11 derived. Legibility and elegance are weaker. (1) The picture's gestalt is a hub-and-spoke of every chapter radiating from 'The grammar', but the standings it is meant to show (11 derived of 117) appear only as a text banner, with nothing per chapter in the drawing. (2) The upper-right quadrant (01/02/03/07) is a hairball where numbers collide with curves ('14 14/88', '5, 14/76', '15'/'1' near 02). 'The grammar' label overflows its circle, a ~250 px empty band separates the banner from the drawing, labels sit inside 01-04 but outside 05-08 although 05 and 07 are large, and the premises' dashed connector crosses the 'Two premises' heading. (3) The 11 derived declarations are named in words nowhere a newcomer reaches: 08 §7 names three plus 'five more' plus three, and the edge record names all 11 only as Lean identifiers with Chinese law names and no home chapter. (4) 212 of 497 uses run backward, the root using the map 60 times against 42 the other way, which the page counts but never explains, so the 'root' looks less foundational than its name. (5) The static connections.svg is a dense band of 1,056 threads that can't be followed thread by thread. The interactive map can, but GitHub shows map.html only as source.

Resolve label collisions (offset edge labels along the curve, or drop labels under 15), shrink the empty band, put every chapter's label in one place, and fit 'The grammar' inside its circle. THEORY-GRAPH.md (via theory_graph.py): add a table 'The eleven derived', one row each with plain-English statement, home section anchor, the grammar law it is a case of, and link to records/one-root-to-its-edge.md. Mark each result's standing in the region lists. scores.q: Q5. Value said plainly, early, with a concrete case, without overclaiming
scores.why: The first screen says early 'What it is for. To audit a selection...' and gives the fishers case and USES.md's 'In brief'. Overclaiming is carefully guarded ('no test designed from it has yet run on a deployed pipeline'; centre 'a reading and not a theorem'). But the value is stated in the account's vocabulary ('what couples into it', 'where its rule can lock on what it already selected'). The one case shows a test whose predictions mostly failed, not what someone gained by using the account. The README's next screen (the opening) makes the strongest value claim ('This is a foundation for AI alignment') in conviction form.

scores.q: Q6. Uses in alignment, wisdom, coordination, human development, other fields
scores.why: theories/becoming/USES.md (read lines 1-60) is what this question asks for. It has a field-by-field table (alignment; people and AI; coordination; human development and 生生; wisdom traditions; sciences) with 'What you can do today / How it stands / What is not claimed', 'Nothing claimed' for how a person develops, 'Fields with no row', nine worked examples one or more per field, and 'What this page does not do'. Add a one-line 'try it' per field pointing at its worked example in USES-EXAMPLES.md.

The site's cards carry reading times and one-line purposes. The front Markdown pages I sized are all under 2 MB (largest GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md 616 KB, 07-SIGNIFICANCE 270 KB), so they render on GitHub, and the spine and connection SVGs render inline. scores.q: Q1 Representability
scores.why: The README's first screen (I read lines 1-28 and the repository sections) works as a landing. It says what the account is, gives one case (IN1), states its use (auditing a selection), names the two premises, gives the Lean and review standing honestly ('none of the central results new mathematics', 'No human review yet') and shows the spine picture. MAP.md, which I read in full, is a good 'Start here'. Three things hold the score down. The English first screen never says the work is written with AI, and calls its review 'A review' where README.zh, ONE-PAGE, MAP and the review packet all say an AI review. The prose is dense with internal terms (couples into, lock on what it already selected, C, 117 central declarations, grammar laws) before any plain sentence says why it matters. And on GitHub the landing runs straight into the 22-28 minute first-person opening and its notes, with no 'ways in' table like the one on the site's home.

scores.q: Q3 Unification and connections
scores.why: I read spine.svg's text, THEORY-GRAPH.md's 'The spine' section and its standings and theses tables, the CROSSWALK.md head, the connections page's text on the site, and theories/README.md's head. The spine keeps the edge kinds apart (formal-reuse solid, interpretive dashed, application dotted, 'related' not drawn and counted) and says 'a dependence, not an agreement in meaning'. scores.q: Q4 How it grew
scores.why: I read theories/LINEAGE.md's head, brief, labels, thread and the first 14 rows of its table, and lineage.svg's text. Six dated phases, a picture, 48 turning points each labelled by what states it (all 48 'public'), quotations with line-level source links, and one thread (the selection mechanism) followed from 2024 to T7's failed bridge. scores.why: The value is stated early: on the README, 'What it is for. To audit a selection...', with 'no test designed from it has yet run on a deployed pipeline'. It does not overclaim.
